title: Noah Lyles Invites Athletes From Any Sport to Race
excerpt: Olympic 100m champion Noah Lyles wants to race athletes from other sports, NFL stars included, in 2026. Why an unfamiliar race builds confidence.
body:
Olympic 100m champion Noah Lyles said heading into 2026 that he wants to race athletes from other sports, NFL players included, and invited ideas for race formats, LetsRun reported in January 2026. He has previously traded public challenges with NFL receiver Tyreek Hill.

For most runners, the equivalent is entering a race outside your usual routine: a new distance, a faster field, or a different format such as cross country or a track meet. These races are uncomfortable because you can't predict the result, and that uncertainty is what builds confidence.

Sign up for one race this season that genuinely makes you nervous. Whatever the result, you will learn more about how you race than from another familiar event.

Source: LetsRun.com
keyTakeaway: Enter one race this season that makes you nervous; unfamiliar challenges build confidence.
